scientific_integrity: A direct orthomodular-lattice proof gives closed formulas at all even widths and positive depths; a separate exhaustive checker covers finite instances only. Scientific comparisons use documented source material and do not certify uniqueness or independent review.
scientific_limitations: Exact counting is limited to finite height-two orthomodular horizontal sums, one nested weakening formula family, and independent uniform full or atomic assignments. Uniform assignment frequencies are not physical quantum probabilities. No classification of formula equivalence classes or all orthomodular lattices is claimed. Historical priority under other quantum-logic or term-function terminology remains unresolved.
title: Exact failure counts and width-depth transition for nested Sasaki weakening
